race.comment: DECANTED (2) is knocking on the door of another win having just found one better at his past couple of starts. He's been costly in those, going under at $2.50 and $2.80 but is racing well and this won't take any more winning. He'll be up on speed and very hard to run down. TUXEDO MISS (10) struggled when in the market last time but had been going okay prior and has genuine each way claims. MISS HIMALAYA (11) stuck on well for third at Wangaratta last time out and should be thereabouts once more. FOREVER WITH NED (3) is fresh for this but good enough at her best and both wins have been on heavy.
